tools.name: list_chords
tools.title: List the 30-day chord journey
tools.description: List every guitar chord in the 30-day journey, in learning order, with its day number, full name and difficulty.

locale.description: Language of the chord names and difficulty labels. Defaults to en-US.

tools.name: get_chord
tools.title: Get how to play a chord
tools.description: Get everything needed to play one chord: which string each finger presses, an ASCII diagram, a beginner tip and famous songs that use it.

name.description: Chord name as shown in the app, e.g. Em, Am, C, G, Dm.

locale.description: Language of the explanation text. Defaults to en-US.

tools.name: get_daily_practice
tools.title: Get a day's practice routine
tools.description: Get the 5-10 minute routine for one day of the journey: today's chord, the chords to review, a strumming pattern with a suggested BPM, and a common mistake to avoid.

day.description: Day of the journey, from 1 to 30.

locale.description: Language of the explanation text. Defaults to en-US.
